hedging_delta.evidence: Prior stressed 'significant macro uncertainty' broadly; current adds concrete 'green shoots' (bookings, cancellations subsiding) alongside caution, slightly more definitive.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided March quarter net sales $1.225B-$1.425B (midpoint $1.325B); current guides June quarter $1.22B-$1.26B (midpoint $1.24B), a lower guide.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: FPGA revenue record >$679M and CHIPS grant $162M are reiterated/new figures without a directly comparable prior forward number to compare against.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New VSI and Neuronix AI Labs acquisitions and planned 64-bit embedded microprocessor entry are introduced, absent from prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Current call adds 'green shoots,' 'bottom of the cycle,' and record dividend/buyback language versus prior's more purely defensive tone.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior described broad weakness and destocking with no bottom in sight; current cites bookings picking up, 'April bookings higher than March,' and expected return to growth in September.
